item.text: On it. I'll have the **Analyst** read your brief against the regulations library first.

messages.text: Brief attached. Find what blocks testable requirements.
Read 3 passages (rbi-digital-payment-security-controls-2021, rbi-kyc-master-direction-2024). 3 gaps to ask about.

steps.name: retrieve · BM25 + Chroma
steps.input: Build a digital banking application for retail customers in India. Include secure login, account balances, fund transfers, transaction history and audit logs. Integrate with the core banking system and support 1,000 concurrent users.

steps.name: analyst · Questions
steps.input: Find what the brief leaves unclear that blocks testable requirements. Ask the project owner 3 or 4 short questions about THEIR project (users, business rules, limits, integrations, volumes, who approves releases, data retention), each about one thing, each with 3-4 short answer options; mark the likeliest recommended. Never quiz them about what regulations say.
steps.output: {"questions": [{"text": "Which authentication factors are required for users initiating fund transfers or beneficiary updates?", "why": "Brief mentions secure login but E3 requires MFA for specific high-risk actions (fund transfers, beneficiary changes) while E2 mandates MFA; ", "options": [{"label": "Password only", "recommended": false}, {"label": "OTP via SMS", "recommended": true}, {"label": "PIN + OTP (Mobile)", "recommended": false}, {"label": "No MFA for low-value transfers under ₹5k", "recommended": false}]}, {"text": "What is the specific user-facing CDD/KYC trigger point for new account creation?", "why": "Brief assumes 'retail customers' but E5 (50k threshold) and E3 (account-based relationship) mandate specific CDD timing; ", "options": [{"label": "Immediate upon sign-up request", "recommended": false}, {"label": "When account is activated", "recommended": true}, {"label": "Only after first transfer", "recommended": false}, {"label": "For transactions >₹1,00,000 only", "recommended": false}]}, {"text": "What is the maximum acceptable account balance or transaction limit per user?", "why": "Brief mentions 'account balances' and 'fund transfers' but no caps are defined, impacting audit/log retention scope; ", "options": [{"label": "Balance up to ₹50,000", "recommended": false}, {"label": "Daily limit ₹50,000", "recommended": false}, {"label": "Balance cap ₹50L; Daily limit ₹2L", "recommended": true}, {"label": "Unlimited for verified users", "recommended": false}]}]}

item.text: A few things in the brief are unclear. I'll ask one at a time — pick an option, write your own, or skip.

questions.text: Which authentication factors are required for users initiating fund transfers or beneficiary updates?
questions.why: Brief mentions secure login but the regulation requires MFA for specific high-risk actions (fund transfers, beneficiary changes) while the regulation mandates MFA;

options.label: No MFA for low-value transfers under ₹5k

questions.text: What is the specific user-facing CDD/KYC trigger point for new account creation?
questions.why: Brief assumes 'retail customers' but the regulation (50k threshold) and the regulation (account-based relationship) mandate specific CDD timing;
